wiringInterpretation.rationale: Plan_final 03-008 wires deterministic input trace record/replay for oracle and acceptance runs. The new src/vanilla/inputTrace.ts exposes VanillaInputTraceRecorder (captures VanillaEvents tagged with a tic timestamp and freezes them into an InputScriptPayload), VanillaInputTraceReplayer (consumes a frozen InputScriptPayload and posts events into a VanillaEventQueue at matching tics), and the convertVanillaEventToInputScriptEvent / convertInputScriptEventToVanillaEvent pure helpers that round-trip the four shared event kinds. The mouse-move script kind has no VanillaEvent analog (motion is accumulated separately by src/input/mouse.ts) and is silently skipped during replay.
